queries.query: SELECT Name, TreatmentPerformed FROM WaterTreatmentFacility WHERE TreatmentPerformed = 'Filtration';
SELECT SUM(ConsumptPerMonthAvg) AS TotalConsumption FROM Business;
SELECT SUM(WasteWaterPerMonthAvg) AS TotalWasteWater FROM Business;
SELECT AVG(ConsumptPerMonthAvg) AS AvgIndustrialConsumption FROM Business WHERE Type = 'Industrial' OR 'Hybrid';
SELECT AVG(WasteWaterPerMonthAvg) AS AvgAgriculturalWasteWater FROM Business WHERE Type = 'Agricultural' OR 'Hybrid';
SELECT Location, PresQual FROM WaterSource WHERE PresQual < 5;
SELECT T.TreatmentName, T.Description FROM Treatment T JOIN TreatmentTime TT ON T.TreatmentName = TT.TreatmentType WHERE TT.TreatedSourceLocation = 'Dropstar River';
SELECT RegulatedTreatment FROM Regulation WHERE IDNumber = 1;
